lines.en: I walk the ridge with my pick over my shoulder.
Gravel grinds under my boots.
I know these mountain paths blindfolded.

lines.zh: 山里的矮人，弓也拉得开。
lines.en: A mountain dwarf can still draw a bow.
Short I am, but my steps are heavy.
I follow the seam of ore.

lines.zh: 风大，我把胡子按进衣领。
lines.en: Windy; I tuck my beard into my collar.

lines.zh: 背上那把弓，走山路正好。
lines.en: The bow on my back suits these mountain trails.
I'm looking for the next mine mouth.

lines.zh: 我踩塌一块浮石，差点滑。
lines.en: A loose stone shifts and I nearly slip.
The wind up here is harder than iron.

lines.zh: 我的靴底嵌着山里的碎石。
lines.en: Bits of mountain stone are stuck in my boot soles.
I sit and hone my pick.
I count the ore in my basket.
Rock dust smells better than ale.
I tug my beard and think.

lines.zh: 这山要是再高些就好了。
lines.en: If only this mountain were taller.
I test the bowstring once more.
If orcs come, I'll be waiting.
I don't care for the shine of gold chests.

lines.zh: 我把碎石垒成一个小小的塔。
lines.en: I stack rubble into a little tower.
My eyelids are heavy, but I don't sleep.
You stand taller than my pick.

lines.zh: 你不是兽人，先不算敌人。
lines.en: You're no orc, so not yet an enemy.
You smell of ore.
Where did that sword come from?

lines.zh: 我得仰起脖子才看得见你。
lines.en: I have to crane my neck to see you.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩坏了我的标记。
lines.en: You've scuffed my marker stones.
Don't kick my ore basket.
Are you crossing, or prospecting?
I squint, measuring your height.

lines.zh: 你的斧子不是我的对手。
lines.en: That axe of yours won't match mine.
My helmet's knocked askew.
Ah, my ribs.
That one drove me back.

lines.zh: 这一下砸在护腕上，虎口发麻。
lines.en: The blow lands on my bracer and my grip goes numb.
I spit out dust and blood.
A tuft of my beard is gone.
I lean on a rock and breathe.
That's a deep one. Noted.

lines.zh: 山里的石头都比我软，你倒不。
lines.en: Even the rocks here are softer than you.
One more and I'll have to fall back.

lines.zh: 那金盒里装的什么，让我看看。
lines.en: What's in that gold chest? Let me see.
That iron in your hand is pure.

lines.zh: 我闻到了酒味，从你包里。
lines.en: I smell ale from your pack.

lines.zh: 你把矿扔下来，我就过去。
lines.en: Drop the ore and I'll come over.
The ring of metal is the sweetest sound.
I stare at the pick on your belt.
The path is narrow; I step aside a little.

lines.zh: 你把金锭举高，我眼睛跟着。
lines.en: You raise a gold ingot and my eyes follow.
That ore's good enough to walk a mile for.

lines.zh: 我抹了把胡子，走了过去。
lines.en: I wipe my beard and walk over.
You knocked my beard crooked.
My pick handle jabs your side.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，尘土飞起。
lines.en: We collide and dust puffs up.
Steady; my basket's about to spill.

lines.zh: 我顶着你往前挪了一步。
lines.en: I brace and shove you back a step.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖碰到我的头盔。
lines.en: Your knee clangs my helmet.
Don't crowd; the ledge is this wide only.

lines.zh: 我退开，石头被我踢下去。
lines.en: I step back and kick a stone loose.

lines.zh: 我们肩膀撞肩膀，谁也不让。
lines.en: Shoulder to shoulder, neither gives way.

lines.zh: 你踩掉了我脚边的碎石。
lines.en: You scatter the gravel at my feet.
You set your pick beside mine.
She's half a head shorter than me.

lines.zh: 我们背靠背坐下，看着山口。
lines.en: We sit back to back and watch the pass.

lines.zh: 她的胡子编成了两条辫子。
lines.en: Her beard is braided in two.

lines.zh: 我们交换了各自挖到的石头。
lines.en: We trade the stones we each dug up.
At last someone in this mountain understands me.

lines.zh: 我们并排挖同一个矿脉。
lines.en: We work the same seam side by side.
By the fire, she leans against me.
Our hammer blows fall into one rhythm.
Mountain days are long; we'll take them slowly.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块铁矿，掂了掂。
lines.en: I pick up iron ore and weigh it.
This stone is good; I'll keep it.
I'll hold the gold chest; don't grab.
Someone dropped a pick; it's mine now.
I sweep the slag into my sack.
This haft will make a new pick.
I pick up an arrow; that one's mine.

lines.zh: 地上一小堆煤，正好烧火。
lines.en: A little coal on the ground; good for the fire.
I stuff it into my belt pouch.

lines.zh: 这块石头有点沉，我喜欢。
lines.en: This stone is heavy. I like that.
Orcs! I'm coming.
You touched my ore.
I draw the bow at your chest.

lines.zh: 矮人的山，不许外人乱走。
lines.en: No outsider wanders a dwarf's mountain.
I've put up with you long enough.

lines.zh: 我把镐扛上肩，冲你点头。
lines.en: I shoulder the pick and nod at you.
Is it your move or mine?
Stepping on my markers is a declaration.
I know that smell; it's hostility.

lines.zh: 我退到石头上，站高了些。
lines.en: I climb onto a stone to gain height.
I'll loose this arrow first.
Mountain folk don't waste words before a fight.
I pull the string to my ear.
There's no path behind you; I checked.

lines.zh: 就算你比我高，也得挨这一下。
lines.en: Taller or not, you'll take this hit.
I swing within three counts.
Go left, and my arrow goes left.

lines.zh: 我细听着你靴底的声音。
lines.en: I listen close to the sound of your soles.
This bow is taller than I am.

lines.zh: 箭头上抹了东西，你知道的。
lines.en: The arrowhead is coated. You know it.
I circle around to the upwind side.
Your legs will slow first.
I count the paces you've taken.

lines.zh: 换个位置，我挪到石块后。
lines.en: I shift behind the boulder.
I know every inch of this ground.
I raise the bow; you raise the shield.
Patience; the arrow's still on the string.

lines.zh: 箭搭上了，药味顺着风飘过去。
lines.en: The arrow is nocked; the potion's smell drifts downwind.
Charge, and you eat this arrow.
The mountain wind will steady my shot.
I won't give an inch of ground.
I hear your armor creaking.
The closer you come, the steadier I am.
The second arrow is already nocked.

lines.zh: 山道就这么宽，你总要走过来。
lines.en: The mountain path is narrow; sooner or later you'll come.
I've swapped to the pick for close work.
My pick comes down in a spray of sparks.
This one rings off your leg guard.
My pick point is sharper than you think.
Your knee buckles, just as I wanted.
I swing full force into your shield.
Dust gets in your eyes.

lines.zh: 矮个子够不着高，我打腿。
lines.en: Short arms; so I strike low.
That one makes you lose your grip.
I jab the haft into your gut.

lines.zh: 挡一下，我就绕到你侧面。
lines.en: Block once and I'll be at your flank.
My blow shatters a chunk of rock.

lines.zh: 你手臂抬不起来了，对吧。
lines.en: Your arm won't rise now, will it?
I strike again while your head is down.
That spins you halfway around.
All my strength is in the wrist.
I sweep the pick's back across your waist.
You're panting harder than I am.
I drive you toward the cliff edge.
One more and you'll be sitting down.
That's enough; don't come back.
I poke my head out of the mine.

lines.zh: 山道上多了一串脚步声。
lines.en: A new set of footsteps joins the trail.
I plant my pick in the ground.
This peak is mine to watch today.
I rise out of a crack in the rock.
I shake the lime dust from my beard.
Someone new has come up the mountain.
In the mountain wind, I nock an arrow.
A short shape steps out of the mist.

lines.zh: 我踩了踩地面，找稳脚处。
lines.en: I stamp the ground for a firm stance.
The mine lamp is lit, and so am I.
Good ground here; I'll stay.
Fire catches my beard and singes it.

lines.zh: 我从石阶滚下去，撞得不轻。
lines.en: I tumble down the stone steps and land hard.

lines.zh: 矿洞进水了，我呛了一口。
lines.en: The mine flooded and I swallowed water.
The blast throws me into the rubble.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我的肩甲，山风太急。
lines.en: An arrow in my pauldron; the mountain wind is sharp.
That spell makes my bones ring.

lines.zh: 我两天没吃东西了，手发抖。
lines.en: Two days without food; my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷打在镐上，我整条手臂都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits my pick; my whole arm goes numb.

lines.zh: 我脚下没底了，往虚空掉。
lines.en: There's no ground; I'm falling into the void.
